article.title: How Israel used AI to relentlessly murder Palestinian journalists and their families in their homes
article.author: Editor
article.content: My new research establishes how the AI program “Where’s Daddy?” was used on an almost daily basis from October to December 2023, when 68 journalists, and hundreds of their family members, were killed. - Andy Worthington The post How Israel used AI to relentlessly murder Palestinian journalists and their families in their homes appeared first on MR Online .
